- **Nazwę serwera MSSQL** (np. `localhost`, `sqlserver.example.com`)

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="mssql_run_query"><details>

Running query on connection 'RetailDW' (ID: 1f58237d-2153-4cbc-8682-88fd4b03c684)

**Input:**

- connectionId: `1f58237d-2153-4cbc-8682-88fd4b03c684`
- query:

```

SELECT 
    SUM(SalesAmount) AS TotalSales
FROM dbo.FactSales fs
INNER JOIN dbo.DimDate dd ON fs.DateKey = dd.DateKey
WHERE dd.FullDateAlternateKey >= '2026-09-24' 
  AND dd.FullDateAlternateKey <= '2026-09-30'

```

- queryTypes: `["SELECT"]`
